mini_task_spec:
In the NestJS monorepo at `test-repo/packages/common/exceptions/`, there are multiple TypeScript files defining HTTP exception classes. Your task is to:

1. Identify every concrete class that **directly extends `HttpException`** (i.e., `export class X extends HttpException`) — excluding `HttpException` itself and `IntrinsicException`.
2. For each such class, look up the numeric HTTP status code it uses (by cross-referencing the `HttpStatus` enum in `test-repo/packages/common/enums/http-status.enum.ts`).
3. Output the full list sorted **ascending by HTTP status code**, one entry per line, in the exact format: `<ClassName> <status_code>`.

Expected answer format: 22 lines, each containing a class name and an integer separated by a single space, sorted numerically by the integer, e.g.:
```
BadRequestException 400
UnauthorizedException 401
...
HttpVersionNotSupportedException 505
```
